newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba-council meeting continues after rate news.
newsitem.headline: Buba-council meeting continues after rate news.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday that its policy-making council was continuing to meet after its announcement that interest rates were unchanged.
A spokesman said the meeting was still going on at 1150 GMT, five minutes after the central bank said it was leaving its key interest rates unchanged.

There had been widespread speculation that the Bundesbank was poised on Thursday to announce plans to exempt securities repurchase transactions from the minimum reserve requirment in order to boost Frankfurt as a financial centre.
